Text.Text: Unauthorized demolition operation: closed. Operator assessment: passed. Apply force within the limits of the structure around you. Worldbreaker trials: complete. Further assignments: none.
Staff proficiency requirement: rank 50. Current clearance: insufficient. Continue training, then return for the demolition trials.

Six operators are conducting uncertified demolition drills at CZ-220. Their work order is required for the failure investigation. Defeat six Worldbreaker Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym. I'll give you the CZ-220 Breaker Yard Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Worldbreaker.

Access credential issued: CZ-220 Breaker Yard Key. Use 'Enter the Breaker Bay' on the CZ-220 Maintenance Level. Keep additional party operators near the entrance during transit. Defeat six Worldbreaker Adepts and return with the work order to this unit at the Dantooine Battle Monster Gym.

Worldbreaker is force that exceeds rated tolerance, applied with intent. A push becomes a break at a calculable threshold. This unit calculates that threshold continuously. Most organics do not, which is why the yard keeps producing structural failures.

Use 'Enter the Breaker Bay' in CZ-220, Maintenance Level. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Worldbreaker Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
Six operators. Improvised staff strikes, inconsistent follow-through. Low structural risk to a prepared operator. High structural risk to an unprepared one. Recommend preparation.
Defeat six Worldbreaker Adepts in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Breaker Yard Work Order; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
You've defeated six Worldbreaker Adepts. Let me see the Worldbreaker Breaker Yard Work Order.
Work order received. Investigation record updated. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

Specialists are misrouting bay power through the junkline relay. Recover the component for inspection. Defeat five Worldbreaker Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
Your key still grants access to CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Defeat five Worldbreaker Specialists to secure the Worldbreaker Junkline Control Relay, then return to me.
Calibrated force requires a calibrated response. These specialists have removed the guesswork the first group carried. You should remove yours as well.

Use 'Enter the Breaker Bay' in CZ-220, Maintenance Level. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Worldbreaker Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
Five specialists. Consistent form, minor variance in follow-through. Structural risk: moderate. This unit rates their probability of a clean hit above the previous group's, by a measurable margin.
Defeat five Worldbreaker Specialists in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Junkline Control Relay; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
You've defeated five Worldbreaker Specialists. Let me see the Worldbreaker Junkline Control Relay.
Relay received. Power-routing fault identified. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden controls the Breaker Bay. Recover the bay sigil to complete this phase of the investigation. Defeat the Worldbreaker Warden in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Sheared Bay Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In CZ-220, Breaker Bay, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Worldbreaker Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Worldbreaker Sheared Bay Sigil.

Her technique demands precision this unit rates above the specialists' by a wide margin. One miscalculated block, and the failure is structural, not superficial. This unit does not recommend testing that alone.
In CZ-220, Breaker Bay, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Worldbreaker Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Worldbreaker Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Worldbreaker Warden in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Sheared Bay Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Worldbreaker Warden. Let me see the Worldbreaker Sheared Bay Sigil.
Bay sigil received. Warden deactivation confirmed. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four operators still authorize unlogged demolition work. Recover the foreman's override chip. Defeat four members of the Worldbreaker Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
Your key still grants access to CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Defeat four members of the Worldbreaker Inner Circle to secure the Worldbreaker Foreman's Override Chip, then return to me.

The Worldbreaker Inner Circle fight together. Bring help if you can, and focus on one opponent at a time. Defeat four members to secure the Worldbreaker Foreman's Override Chip; simultaneous kills aren't required.

Use 'Enter the Breaker Bay' in CZ-220, Maintenance Level. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat four members of the Worldbreaker Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Worldbreaker Inner Circle fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.
Defeat four members of the Worldbreaker Inner Circle in CZ-220, Breaker Bay. Their defeat secures the Worldbreaker Foreman's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym.
You've defeated four members of the Worldbreaker Inner Circle. Let me see the Worldbreaker Foreman's Override Chip.
Override chip received. Unauthorized orders disabled. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master remains active in the Breaker Yard. Defeat it to complete the structural failure investigation. Defeat the Worldbreaker Master in CZ-220, Breaker Yard. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In CZ-220, Breaker Yard, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Worldbreaker Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

It demands you understand what exceeding your own rating means. This unit is not permitted to exceed its own rating; the safety governor prevents it. The master's governor, whatever it was, did not hold. This unit does not know what replaces a governor that fails. Neither, this unit suspects, does the master.
In CZ-220, Breaker Yard, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Worldbreaker Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.
Recommended deployment: you and two additional operators. Target: Worldbreaker Master. Multiple operators distribute incoming force. Solo entry is permitted; risk remains high.

Defeat the Worldbreaker Master in CZ-220, Breaker Yard. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Battle Monster Gym; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Worldbreaker Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.

Unauthorized demolition operation: closed. Operator assessment: passed. Apply force within the limits of the structure around you. You've earned the right to train Worldbreaker. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the job.

Back to the job.

What makes her different?
Where do I find her?

Back to the job.

Why does the formation matter?

Back to the job.

Where do I find it?
What's it going to do to us?
I need to find two more who'll come.
The Worldbreaker Master is defeated. Here's my report.
